ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate 'ShieldCheck' import from lucide-react caused Compile error blocking the ENTIRE frontend (all pages showed 'Compiled with problems'). Fixed by removing the trailing duplicate on line 8.

action_items: None — the ShieldCheck duplicate-import bug was fixed by the testing agent. Verified end-to-end BOC-3, Shipper Intake, Public Intake, Onboarding, CheckCallHud all functional.
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar.jsx imports 40+ icons from lucide-react in one giant destructuring statement — duplicate identifiers slipped in unnoticed. Consider splitting into 2-3 logical groups or using a linter rule (no-duplicate-imports) to catch this at commit time.

boc3_compliance.py `_days_until` uses `.days` on a timedelta which floors down, so a filing at 30.5 days shows 30d (RED) rather than YELLOW — this matches the intent stated in the prompt (≤30d = RED) but be aware of boundary flakiness at midnight-of-day-30.

Boc3Compliance FilingDialog does not confirm before overwriting an existing accepted filing (upsert semantics) — a user tapping a state that already has an ACCEPTED cert can silently overwrite it. Consider a confirm dialog when `existing?.status === 'ACCEPTED'`.

PublicIntake page uses axios directly bypassing api.js — that's correct because /i/:token is unauthenticated. Just document this in code so future refactors don't accidentally rewire it through the authed client.

CheckCallHud renders `check-call-current-status` badge conditionally on `cur` truthiness — a newly-created booking with no transit_status shows no badge, which is fine but subtly different from 'PENDING' state.
Frontend `boc3-status-select` uses radix Select which pops options in a portal — force=true is needed for tests, worth documenting in the component.

rca of the issue: Frontend was broken by a duplicate `ShieldCheck` identifier declared twice in Sidebar.jsx's single-statement destructuring import from lucide-react (line 8). Root cause: main agent added ShieldCheck to the trailing group of icons without noticing it was already declared earlier in the same import. Symptom: Webpack Compile error, entire SPA rendered as 'Compiled with problems' overlay. Fix: removed the redundant trailing `, ShieldCheck`. Regression risk mitigation: enable eslint rule `no-duplicate-imports` or split icon imports by category.
